newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIAN SHIPPING ELECTS NEW PRESIDENT.
newsitem.headline: LATVIAN SHIPPING ELECTS NEW PRESIDENT.

text.p: Latvian Shipping, one of the country's largest companies, on Tuesday elected Andris Klavinsh as the company's president.
Klavinsh was until recently senior vice president of the company, which is on the government's privatisation list.
The shareholder meeting of the company also elected Ivars Godmanis as board member. Godmanis is also currently president of Savings Bank (Krajbanka), also on the privatisation list.
Klavinsh replaced Peteris Avotinsh, who was sacked after the company reported two years of losses.
